umijs/qiankun#1089.resolution: deferred beforeUnmount精确停住旧卸载，再次mount必须等待；重复mount、重复unmount、最新卸载胜出、首个未完成mount取消后再次mount、lifecycle同步重入；验证最终状态/计数器实际点击/旧frame断连或保留/单一surface。修复AppController串行卸载与最新请求处理。 补充maxInstances=0直接卸载与立即remount，避免self.dispose等待其发起的淘汰循环；同步dispose lifecycle监听器的mount请求被拒绝，unmount/dispose各调用1次。

tests.title: W823 awaits asynchronous React beforeUnmount before remounting with working events (keepAlive=false)
W823 awaits asynchronous React unmount before remounting with working events (keepAlive=false)
W823 awaits asynchronous React beforeUnmount before reactivating with working events (keepAlive=true)
W823 awaits asynchronous React deactivate before reactivating with working events (keepAlive=true)

Tencent/wujie#823.resolution: 真实React19.2.8 createRoot四组：keepAlive=false分别暂停beforeUnmount hook和应用unmount，结束后新frame/root且按钮状态重置；keepAlive=true分别暂停beforeUnmount hook和应用deactivate，结束后同frame/root、计数状态保留且按钮继续可交互。均在旧异步阶段未释放时请求mount并断言unmounting未提前结束；每例最终Runtime.destroy清理。公开契约明确keepAlive=true的隐藏执行deactivate，不声称其调用unmount。
